name: Jikan
tagline: Unofficial MyAnimeList API for anime and manga data
description: Jikan is a free, unofficial REST API that provides access to MyAnimeList data including anime, manga, characters, people, clubs, and user profiles. It scrapes and caches MAL content so developers can build anime apps without official MAL API access. Public endpoints require no authentication.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public REST API. Rate limits apply per IP. Optional paid/higher-tier hosting may exist via third parties; core service is free and keyless.

use_cases: get anime details by MyAnimeList ID
search anime by title or genre
get character and voice actor data
